text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the academy, I spotted Phalaenopsis 
chatting with her cousin, 
Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed, we often played together back 
then. 
Tag, hide-and-seek, and kick the can.
choice_data_list: Reminiscing about when you were kids?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have quite the story, too. 
During one game of kick the can, Brian—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember that. Brian hid so well 
that we simply couldn't find her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... But because she hid a little too 
well, 
the poor girl grew lonely. Eventually, she 
burst into tears, 
which was how we finally figured out where 
she was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Quit using me as fodder 
for your cheap laughs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies. I was overcome with 
nostalgia. 
If you'd like, why don't we play again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I will. 
I'm not a kid anymore.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You certainly have changed. 
To think someone like you has learned to 
make 
convenient excuses just to dodge a 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Cut the weird phrasing. 
You really think I'm gonna fall for that?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So you haven't changed after all? 
Still the same crybaby Brian I hold in my 
memories?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. ...Seems your tongue's 
gotten sharper than it used to be.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then why not see if you can make me 
cry? 
You can avenge that past humiliation in 
that very same game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...... Just once. 
If it's being "it", I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three cousins held 
a rematch of kick the can, 
years in the making.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
First up, Sis. ...Knowing her tastes, 
she's probably hiding somewhere 
with plenty of cover like this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just as expected, you know me well. 
Yet that is not the only advantage this 
spot offers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Should I be discovered, I can slip to 
another tree unnoticed. 
A slightly unfair ploy, made possible only 
by 
my present athletic prowess. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...... 
Hey, Sis. Your head is sticking out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You could stand to 
grow up a little, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Ngh...! Brian... 
Since when did you become so cheeky...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. 
I never should've agreed to this. 
Scouring around for people was never my 
style.

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Where are you hiding?! 
Phalaeno-chan, you scaredy-cat! 
You weird chameleon!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaeno
text_block_list.text: Wh-What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. 
Yeah, that did happen. ......

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You're nearby, aren't you? Come on 
out, 
you scaredy-cat, weird chameleon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. To think you'd come out the exact 
same way. 
Seems you're the one who hasn't grown at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I merely found it amusing 
that you remembered the past 
so vividly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Now then, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, not an ounce of waste in her path...! 
She mapped out a direct line to the can 
beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I never said 
I hadn't made preparations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Don't think cheap tricks like that 
are gonna close the gap between us!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Haha. That was an intriguing 
contest. 
It truly feels as though I've returned to 
my childhood.
choice_data_list:
When all's said and done, your bond hasn't 
changed at all.

At the end of the day, some things really 
haven't changed.

Now that you've both grown up, has 
anything changed between you?

text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Haha. That was an intriguing 
contest. 
It truly feels as though I've returned to 
my childhood.
choice_data_list:
When all's said and done, your bond hasn't 
changed at all.

At the end of the day, some things really 
haven't changed.

Now that you've both grown up, has 
anything changed between you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'hasn't changed'? Count 
me out of— 
Hey! Sis, what are you smirking at?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well, I suppose doing this 
once in a while isn't so bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There is. ...Namely, that this one has 
learned 
to run her irritating mouth.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then shall I say you are just as 
darling 
as you were in the days of old?
